cases.purpose: Retry EINTR at gzip member boundaries including EOF and a concatenated member; reject zero writes during encoding for all formats and allow a subsequent invocation.
cases.oracle: Python gzip creates independent members and plaintext; pinned seccomp notification helper records injected calls. A zero write must fail once with a diagnostic.
cases.comparison: Exact status and stdout; log assertions verify fault delivery and no repeated zero write.

files.fixture.py:
import gzip, json, sys
if sys.argv[1] == "make":
    a, b = b"first member\n", b"second member\n"
    g = bytearray(gzip.compress(a, mtime=0))
    extra = 65536 - len(g) - 2
    assert 0 <= extra <= 65535
    g[3] |= 4
    g = g[:10] + extra.to_bytes(2, "little") + bytes(extra) + g[10:]
    assert len(g) == 65536 and gzip.decompress(g) == a
    open("single.gz", "wb").write(gzip.compress(a, mtime=0))
    open("concat.gz", "wb").write(g + gzip.compress(b, mtime=0))
    open("single.want", "wb").write(a)
    open("concat.want", "wb").write(a + b)
    open("plain", "wb").write(bytes(range(256)) * 1024)
elif sys.argv[1] == "reads":
    calls = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2])]
    assert len(calls) >= 3 and calls[0]["reply"] == "continue" and calls[1]["reply"] == "errno:4" and calls[2]["reply"] == "continue", calls
elif sys.argv[1] == "writes":
    calls = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2])]
    assert len(calls) == 1 and calls[0]["reply"] == "value:0", calls

cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
/usr/bin/python3 fixture.py make || exit 1
for name in single concat; do
  /usr/bin/python3 "$H" --notify read:0=0 --reply-seq read=continue,EINTR --log "$HOME/read.jsonl" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "zlib < $name.gz > out" || exit 1
  /usr/bin/python3 fixture.py reads "$HOME/read.jsonl" || exit 1
  /usr/bin/cmp -s out "$name.want" || exit 1
  /usr/bin/rm "$HOME/read.jsonl"
  printf '%s boundary retry ok\n' "$name"
done
for fmt in gzip zlib deflate xz lzma zstd bzip2; do
  /usr/bin/python3 "$H" --notify write:0=1 --reply-seq write=0 --log "$HOME/write.jsonl" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "zlib -e -f $fmt < plain > out 2> err; : > status-\$?" || exit 1
  [[ -f status-1 && -s err ]] || exit 1
  /usr/bin/python3 fixture.py writes "$HOME/write.jsonl" || exit 1
  /usr/bin/rm "$HOME/write.jsonl" status-1
  zlib -e -f "$fmt" < plain > encoded || exit 1
  zlib -d -f "$fmt" < encoded > decoded || exit 1
  /usr/bin/cmp -s plain decoded || exit 1
  printf '%s encode zero and recovery ok\n' "$fmt"
done
cases.stdout:
single boundary retry ok
concat boundary retry ok
gzip encode zero and recovery ok
zlib encode zero and recovery ok
deflate encode zero and recovery ok
xz encode zero and recovery ok
lzma encode zero and recovery ok
zstd encode zero and recovery ok
bzip2 encode zero and recovery ok
